findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 9 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 70 questions numbered 1-70; by section: 9.1 8, 9.2 4, 9.3 7, 9.4 6, 9.5 8, 9.6 5, 9.7 7, 9.8 8, 9.8~2 6, 9.9 11.

Covers sections 9.1-9.9 in order (with the salt hydrolysis section printed as a second 9.8); comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's sample problems and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (NH₄⁺ conjugate acid of NH₃, Kw = Kc[H₂O], Table 9.2 powers 10⁻¹⁴, [H⁺] = 10⁻ᵖᴴ, Ka = x²/(C − x), KClO₃ → ClO₃⁻, PbSO₄ Ksp 1.6 × 10⁻⁸, methyl orange red in acid); misprinted Table 9.3 Ka values and Kw at 100 °C not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
